name: Role-play Benchmark
intro: Role-play Benchmark旨在通过情景重现来评估角色扮演代理提供沉浸式体验的能力。它不寻求“正确”答案，而是专注于检测与角色设定不符的“错位”之处，例如逻辑矛盾或脱离角色的行为。
build_method: 内部角色设定嵌入聚类、LLM 语义聚合与人工核验；模型对模型长对话自博弈
metric: Worlds, Stories, User Preferences weighted score
eval_feature: 100 轮对话、每场景 3 次独立会话、每 20 轮切块评判、人工偏好校准
scale: 公开子集含 95 个中英文种子与 3,135 个对话会话
build_method_en: Embedding clustering of internal character settings, LLM semantic aggregation, human verification, and model-on-model long-dialogue self-play
eval_feature_en: 100-turn dialogues, 3 independent sessions per scenario, 20-turn judging chunks, and human-preference calibration
intro_en: The Role-play Benchmark aims to evaluate the ability of role-playing agents to provide immersive experiences through scenario reenactment. It does not seek "correct" answers but focuses on detecting "discrepancies" inconsistent with the character setting, such as logical contradictions or out-of-character behavior.
scale_en: Public subset: 95 Chinese/English seeds and 3,135 dialogue sessions
metric_en: Worlds, Stories, User Preferences weighted score
drawio_review_note: Aligned with MiniMax role-play-bench dataset card and MiniMax-M2-her technical blog Sections 2.1-2.2; no standalone benchmark paper is published. Role-play Benchmark has no standalone paper, so the diagram follows MiniMax's official dataset card and technical blog while marking that evidence boundary. The internal pipeline clusters more than one million NPC/user prompts with embeddings, aggregates semantic tags with an LLM, verifies them with humans, and samples Chinese and English settings. A model-on-model user simulator then runs 100-turn self-play three times per setting. Only NPC outputs are judged, in 20-turn chunks, across Basics, Logic, Knowledge, Diversity, Content Logic, and Interaction with regular human calibration. Worlds, Stories, and User Preferences contribute 50%, 25%, and 25%. The public partial release contains 50 Chinese and 45 English seeds with 3,135 dialogue sessions.
